utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can help with the repair drive, and I’ll grab the spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, then we just need the trim and hinges left.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ve got the list in order. Sam’s checking the drive and cables, Bo can handle the spare parts, and I’m making sure we only flag the most urgent fixes for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, I’ll keep pickup flexible once the timing is set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, then I’ll keep the list tight and let you know if anything urgent comes up before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive’s at the hall right now, and I’ve still got the gate latch and porch step on my list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good to hear the drive’s at the hall. I’ll check the drive and cables and let you know if anything needs replacing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll keep the gate latch and porch step on the list, and I’ll let Faye know the timing after I check in with her.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that too, Noah. Vik’s got the trim and hinges, and I can pitch in on the repair drive if needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check the repair drive update and let Mara know what I’m on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help too if anything comes up on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Noah said he'll check the repair drive update and report back on what he was assigned.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know. Keep me posted if they need an extra hand or transport.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, I’ll keep you posted if Noah needs an extra hand or a ride.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Rosa’s got the list ready, and Cleo’s already signed up. If you still need anything fixed, tell Rosa so she can check it off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tell Rosa I need the drive itself and a quick check of the cables.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, I’ll tell Rosa you need the drive itself and a quick cable check.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m on the brackets and hinge, and if there’s time I can check the porch light too. Eli’s stopping by after lunch to see what still needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Gus has the tools ready, and Rosa’s got the list in order. We can start with the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, the repair drive’s this afternoon at the hall, and I’ll keep spreading the word after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, so Bo should take Opal’s spare parts to the hall, and Rosa’s got the list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, and I’ll swing by after lunch too in case they need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is Pia sorted on timing and transport, or do we need to make a quick plan before the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll sort Pia’s timing and transport now, and I’ll have the tools ready for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, then let’s keep it that way and make sure Pia has the timing nailed down before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll stop by the hall after lunch and see what still needs moving for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think that’s right. Faye has the pickup timing covered, and Jules is already on the electrical fixes and front porch latch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right. I’ll still check the hall after lunch and see what needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Cleo. I’ll keep an eye out and let you handle the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, I’ll sort through what still needs fixing and keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good. I’ll keep an ear out for Noah’s update while you sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo should take the spare parts from my porch straight to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming: it’s tonight, and who’s driving the parts over?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s tonight, and Bo’s handling the parts from my porch to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, I’ll wait for Noah’s update and keep the repair list straight with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, the trim and hinges are all that’s left on the repair drive. I’ll keep that list in order.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, I’ll keep it in order and wait for Noah’s update on the trim and hinges.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with the repair drive, and I’ll grab the spare parts for Opal.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m on the brackets and hinge, and Vik’s walking me through the trim. I’ll check the porch light if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, I’ve got the spare parts. Tell me when the timing’s set and I’ll line up pickup around the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s tonight, right? Who’s driving?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m checking the update now, then I’ll tell Mara what I got assigned.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s tonight, but who’s actually driving?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Who’s driving, and by what time do we need it handled? I’m worried about getting the transport and supplies sorted in time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo can handle it by taking the spare parts from my porch straight to the repair drive, and we should have it sorted as soon as possible.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but I still want to know exactly when Bo can be there and whether the parts are already packed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — keep me posted if you need an extra hand or transport for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the drive and the cables at the hall, and I’ll let you know if anything needs replacing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll sort out what still needs fixing, and I’m glad Quinn and Oren are covering their parts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ve got the list in order and I’m checking the urgent fixes first. Sam’s on the drive and cables, and Bo can grab the spare parts so we’re ready for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, then I’ll keep sorting the remaining fixes while you’ve got the list and the urgent ones covered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, so Jules has the electrical fixes and the front porch latch, and Noah already flagged the gate latch and one porch step. I just want to make sure Faye is still covering the pickup around the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Rosa’s got the list and is checking what’s still needed, and Cleo’s already signed up too. I can ask around about Faye’s pickup timing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so Rosa is checking the remaining needs and Cleo’s in, and I’ll wait on Faye’s pickup timing until you can confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Rosa’s got the list ready, so Bo should just take the spare parts from Opal’s porch straight to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll grab the tools and head over to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, then Gus can take the tools and the spare parts to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with the repair drive, too. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can take the shelf brackets or the loose hinge if that helps. I’ve got time to check the porch light after that, too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s this afternoon at the hall, and I’ll keep spreading the word. I’m swinging by after lunch too, just in case they need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I still need the drive itself and a quick check of the cables.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, the drive and cables are the main things to sort, and I’ll make sure that gets passed along when I stop by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, I can fit pickup around the repair drive once you have the timing set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, the repair drive is still at the hall. I’ll let you know the timing as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, just keep me posted when you know the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Noah said he'd check the repair drive update and tell us what he was assigned.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, but what about Pia's timing and transport concerns? Has anyone sorted those out yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, but I’d ask Noah to check Pia’s timing and transport too so we can sort the rest together.
